name: Entity Is Public
description: Provides an API for determining which entities are publicly accessible.
project_description: Entity Is Public provides a service and hook API for determining whether a content entity (or an entire entity type) is publicly accessible, meaning visible to anonymous users. The entity_is_public service centralises the logic other features need: it checks whether the entity type is public (content entity, not internal, has a canonical URL and view builder, not opted out via config), whether the entity is published, and whether an anonymous session has 'view' access to it, then lets modules veto the result through hook_entity_is_public() and hook_entity_is_public_alter(). It ships integrations for Field Redirection, Metatag (noindex), Micronode, Path (require alias), Rabbit Hole, System 403/404 pages, Trash and XML Sitemap so that non-public entities are excluded from sitemaps and marked noindex. The module reports accessibility for consumers such as sitemaps, search indexing and feeds; it does not itself grant or restrict access.
